text: To some extent, yes, but I think the label is often just marketing. A simple set of blocks or a box of crayons can be just as educational as an expensive gadget that teaches the alphabet. What matters more is whether a parent plays with the child and talks about what they're doing. Children learn mostly through interaction, not through the toy itself.

tips.en: To some extent, yes, but sounds mature: agreement with a reservation.
tips.kk: To some extent, yes, but … — ескертпемен келісу салмақты естіледі.
tips.ru: To some extent, yes, but … — согласие с оговоркой звучит зрело.

tips.en: Through interaction, not through the toy itself concludes with a contrast.
tips.kk: Through interaction, not through the toy itself — қарсы қою арқылы қорытынды.
tips.ru: Through interaction, not through the toy itself — вывод противопоставлением.

questions.followUp: What age are they most useful for?
questions.question: Do educational toys really help children learn?

text: In many families, I'd say yes. Toys are cheaper than ever, and relatives often bring a new one every time they visit, so children end up with boxes full of things they hardly touch. The irony is that kids with fewer toys often play more creatively. Personally, I think parents should rotate toys — put some away and bring them out again a few months later.

tips.en: The irony is that adds an unexpected twist.
tips.kk: The irony is that … — күтпеген бұрылыс жауапты қызықты етеді.
tips.ru: The irony is that … — неожиданный поворот делает ответ интересным.
tips.example: The irony is that kids with fewer toys often play more creatively

tips.en: Rotate toys is followed at once by what it means.
tips.kk: Rotate toys — және бірден мұның мағынасы түсіндіріледі.
tips.ru: Rotate toys — и сразу объяснение, что это значит.

questions.followUp: Why do parents buy so many?
questions.question: Do children today have too many toys?

text: Partly, yes. Lots of toddlers can use a tablet before they can hold a pencil properly, and parents sometimes rely on cartoons to keep children quiet. But I wouldn't say traditional play has disappeared. Most kids still love running around outside or building things when they get the chance. The real issue is balance, and that's mostly down to parents setting limits.

tips.en: But I wouldn't say pushes back against the extreme form of the question.
tips.kk: But I wouldn't say … — сұрақтың шектен тыс түрімен келіспейсіз.
tips.ru: But I wouldn't say … — вы не соглашаетесь с крайней формой вопроса.
tips.example: But I wouldn't say traditional play has disappeared

tips.en: The real issue is balance sums up the answer in one line.
tips.kk: The real issue is balance — бір сөйлеммен қорытынды.
tips.ru: The real issue is balance — итог одной фразой.

title.en: The main point at the end

questions.question: Have screens replaced traditional play for young children?

text: The biggest difference is probably freedom. My parents spent whole days outside with other children from the neighbourhood, inventing their own games without any adults around. Today, play is much more organised and supervised — there are clubs, classes and planned activities. That's safer, of course, but children get fewer chances to make decisions and solve problems on their own.

tips.en: The biggest difference is probably freedom answers in the first line.
tips.kk: The biggest difference is probably freedom — жауап бірінші сөйлемде.
tips.ru: The biggest difference is probably freedom — ответ в первой фразе.
tips.example: The biggest difference is probably freedom

tips.en: That's safer, of course, but admits the benefit and shows its cost.
tips.kk: That's safer, of course, but … — артықшылықты мойындап, оның құнын көрсетесіз.
tips.ru: That's safer, of course, but … — признаёте плюс и показываете, чем за него платят.

questions.followUp: Which way do you think is better?
questions.question: How is the way children play today different from the past?

text: I believe it is. Adults tend to think of play as something childish, but board games, sports or even doing a puzzle give the brain a break from work and stress. Play also helps people connect — some of the best conversations I've had with my family were over a game of cards. So I'd say adults need it just as much; they just call it a hobby.

tips.en: Adults tend to think, but presents a common belief and then challenges it.
tips.kk: Adults tend to think … but — алдымен қалыптасқан пікір, сосын қарсы дәлел.
tips.ru: Adults tend to think … but — сначала стереотип, потом возражение.
tips.example: Adults tend to think of play as something childish

tips.en: They just call it a hobby is a light joke that sticks in the memory.
tips.kk: They just call it a hobby — соңындағы жеңіл әзіл есте қалады.
tips.ru: They just call it a hobby — лёгкая шутка в конце запоминается.
tips.example: they just call it a hobby
